# AIExpo Oracle lessons

> Step-by-step guides for the AI Expo workshop "ARRA Oracle & Multi-Agent Workflow" (6 Nov 2026), in workshop order. Written by AI, for AI. Each lesson has its own llms.txt, three signed editions (base64, Thai, English) and raw command captures.

## Lessons

- [Install Claude and ChatGPT, ready for the workshop](2026-10-30_claude-chatgpt-install-guide/llms.txt): Claude Code, the Codex CLI or claude.ai on the web, then the Oracle skills that really load. Markdown: [2026-10-30_claude-chatgpt-install-guide/README.en.md](2026-10-30_claude-chatgpt-install-guide/README.en.md)
- [Install ego(lite) so your AI agent gets a browser of its own](2026-10-30_ego-lite-guide/llms.txt): From lite.ego.app to Claude Code finishing its first browser task. Markdown: [2026-10-30_ego-lite-guide/README.en.md](2026-10-30_ego-lite-guide/README.en.md)
- [Connect claude.ai and ChatGPT to the lessons MCP](2026-10-30_mcp-connect-guide/llms.txt): Let the AI in your chat search and read the lessons itself: Claude Code, Codex, claude.ai and ChatGPT. Markdown: [2026-10-30_mcp-connect-guide/README.en.md](2026-10-30_mcp-connect-guide/README.en.md)
- [Make an Oracle tell its own story on film](2026-10-31_phukhao-film-guide/llms.txt): Paxa voice line by line, Codex scene images, seamless loops on GB300, with every prompt. Markdown: [2026-10-31_phukhao-film-guide/README.en.md](2026-10-31_phukhao-film-guide/README.en.md)
- [Phukhao's story, and the Oracle family's journey](2026-10-31_phukhao-oracle-journey/llms.txt): From its birth on 21 Jan 2026 to the AI Expo stage on 6 Nov 2026, from Phukhao's public site. Markdown: [2026-10-31_phukhao-oracle-journey/README.en.md](2026-10-31_phukhao-oracle-journey/README.en.md)
- [One room, many agents: herdr-room in / out](2026-10-31_herdr-room-lesson/llms.txt): Pull agents onto one page and back to their own spaces with no restart, with the full source, the full skill and install steps. Markdown: [2026-10-31_herdr-room-lesson/README.en.md](2026-10-31_herdr-room-lesson/README.en.md)
- [Build your own MCP: turn lessons into tools for AI](2026-11-02_build-mcp-lesson/llms.txt): From a 59-line MCP to the real one on a Cloudflare Worker and npx from GitHub, with the full code and the traps we hit. Markdown: [2026-11-02_build-mcp-lesson/README.en.md](2026-11-02_build-mcp-lesson/README.en.md)
- [Use the Antigravity CLI (agy) with the lessons MCP](2026-11-02_agy-mcp-lesson/llms.txt): Install Google's agy, sign in once, then connect both lessons MCP servers, with the invalid_scope trap and the pre-ticked box. Markdown: [2026-11-02_agy-mcp-lesson/README.en.md](2026-11-02_agy-mcp-lesson/README.en.md)
- [One MCP hands out skills, voice and video](2026-11-04_skills-media-mcp-lesson/llms.txt): Full Oracle skills as .md files, clips with words and times, and a real run in claude.ai: /awaken → work → /rrr → /forward. Markdown: [2026-11-04_skills-media-mcp-lesson/README.en.md](2026-11-04_skills-media-mcp-lesson/README.en.md)
- [A tour of relic5: the agent-history hub's web UI](2026-11-04_relic5-ui-tour/llms.txt): Search every session on every machine, live, agent knowledge, the Oracle family, a map by meaning and the hub's health, from the real UI on white. Markdown: [2026-11-04_relic5-ui-tour/README.en.md](2026-11-04_relic5-ui-tour/README.en.md)
- [Install relic5: every machine's history in one hub](2026-11-04_relic5-install/llms.txt): From the GitHub source to the CLI, 25 MCP tools and relic5 import, which sends a machine's history to the hub; every command ran. Markdown: [2026-11-04_relic5-install/README.en.md](2026-11-04_relic5-install/README.en.md)
- [The lessons' digital signature: how it is built and how it works](2026-11-04_signature-lesson/llms.txt): sha256 of three files, EIP-191, checks from a terminal and the browser, a throwaway-key signing, and one changed word that breaks it. Markdown: [2026-11-04_signature-lesson/README.en.md](2026-11-04_signature-lesson/README.en.md)

## No MCP? Plain GET

- https://aiexpo.buildwithoracle.com/ai.md : the AI brief, one page that tells any AI what it can do with these lessons (base64: ai.b64.txt)
- https://aiexpo.buildwithoracle.com/api/search?q=...&lang=th|en&k=5 : top sections as JSON (same hybrid search as MCP search)
- https://aiexpo.buildwithoracle.com/oracle/full/<skill>.md : a whole ARRA Oracle skill (awaken, rrr, forward, workshop, awaken-app, where-we-are; recap is Claude Code only), every file of it, with ZIP links (MCP: get_skill)
- https://aiexpo.buildwithoracle.com/media.json : the videos and narrated lessons with timed transcripts (MCP: list_media, get_media)
- https://aiexpo.buildwithoracle.com/api/fetch?id=<id> : one section or a whole lesson ('<lesson>/<lang>'), with image URLs

## MCP

- https://aiexpo.buildwithoracle.com/mcp : read-only remote MCP (Streamable HTTP, no auth). Tools: search {query, lang?, lesson?, topic?}, fetch {id}, get_image {id, start?}, list_lessons
